hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE '\.php$' && cd /home/user/jobs.kretiv.co && vendor/bin/pint --dirty 2>/dev/null; true
hooks.statusMessage: Running Pint on dirty PHP files...

hooks.command: cd /home/user/jobs.kretiv.co; [ -d vendor ] || composer install --no-interaction --no-progress; [ -d node_modules ] || npm install; [ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env; if [ -z "$(grep '^APP_KEY=' .env 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2)" ]; then php artisan key:generate --force; fi; if [ "$(grep '^DB_CONNECTION=' .env 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2)" = "sqlite" ] && [ ! -f database/database.sqlite ]; then touch database/database.sqlite; php artisan migrate --force; fi; true
